name: Marvon's Workshop
label: Quest
description: Marvon's Workshop: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I managed to spy on what Muigin was doing, and he's actually growing the darn things over there!
I think the only solution here is to... No, not go talk to him... What are you thinking? The solution is to fight back!
We'll need the help of my friend, Marvon, who has a workshop in Ratchet. I'm sure he'll be able to create some sort of gadget that will help us.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Marvon's been gone quite a long time now, friend. He went off to Tanaris to study some of the ancient troll ruins.
Now, what was it that you said you needed?
